title: Source (v1)
description: A primary source that has been ingested by the pipeline: one output/<source-id>/ directory viewed through an adapter. Canvas plan §10.1. This record is a derived index projection; the canonical directory remains the source of truth.

id.description: Two-part <source_type>:<external_id>. Must equal the join of those two fields; enforced by test, not expressible in JSON Schema.

external_id.description: The id in the source system. For YouTube this is metadata.json video_id, which stays named video_id in every canonical file (ADR 0001 invariant 6).

url.description: Canonical URL of the source, or null when the source has none. Never fabricated.

author.description: Publisher or author as recorded by the adapter — YouTube channel, Twitter/X handle, Medium author. Null when the canonical metadata does not carry one.

language.description: Language tag copied from canonical metadata. Not normalised, not guessed.

duration_sec.description: Media duration for time-based sources; null for text sources.

canonical_dir.description: Project-relative path of output/<source-id>/. Read-only to the UI; raw/ inside it is immutable evidence (ADR 0001 invariant 1).

status.description: Run status, read from the canonical validator files only. Never recomputed, never inferred, never coerced toward PASS (ADR 0001 invariant 2).

validation.description: The 'status' field of validation.json, verbatim. UNKNOWN when the file is missing or unreadable.

overall.description: The top-level 'status' of validation.json, which already aggregates all five sections including coverage. Copied, not derived.

audit_attempts.$comment: The floor is 0, not 1. coverage.py writes audit_attempts: 0 into every freshly imported run, and WORKFLOW.md §4 calls 0 the honest never-audited state; validators.py accepts it while the document does not claim PASS (an unaudited PASS is 'unaudited_coverage_pass'). A floor of 1 made the Source record of every scaffolded run schema-invalid, which nothing caught because nothing validated a scaffolded run's record. The cap of 3 is constants.MAX_AUDIT_ATTEMPTS and stays.
audit_attempts.description: coverage.json audit_attempts, verbatim. Capped at 3 by WORKFLOW.md.

counts.description: Cached counts for list rendering. A cache convenience only: every count must be reproducible from the canonical files, and a stale count is a bug, never a data achievement.

artifact_ids.description: Global ids of the artifacts belonging to this source.

adapter_metadata.description: Source-specific fields the generic model does not model — for YouTube: transcript_source, transcript_hash, pipeline_version, extraction. Free-form on purpose: an adapter must never be forced to drop canonical metadata, and must never be tempted to smuggle it into a typed field where it does not belong.
